title: Analytical mechanics
purpose: Derive equations of motion from variational principles and use symmetries to identify conserved quantities.

blocks.deliverable: Count degrees of freedom and choose suitable coordinates.
Derive an equation of motion directly from an action.
Relate a cyclic coordinate to a conserved momentum.
Week 7 midterm; classify an equilibrium and its normal modes.
Compute canonical momenta and a Hamiltonian.
Check a transformation with its bracket relations.
Submit two derivations and complete a mechanics examination.

project: Derive and solve the small oscillations of a coupled mechanical system by two methods.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
